narr: The combination of a cold front moving south and moderate to strong instability resulted in scattered thunderstorms across the Concho Valley and Heartland. A few storms were severe with large hail and damaging winds. Also, flash flooding due to torrential rainfall was reported in San Angelo during the evening.
ev: The San Angelo Police Department reported several water rescues across the city.
